_note: THE RULE, DELIVERED ONCE, ON THE FIRST TILE OF THE FIRST GANTRY. One script, one tile, one onceFlag, because a line that fires on every crossing turns the only mechanism this Hall has into an interruption. It fires on the gantry itself and not on the sill in front of it: stepping off the rock is the moment worth marking.
